about:
Forty-two ratings from Table 31.2 of the Spanish edition: seven stud walls, each rated in six conditions. The page prints one row per framing and six columns under the spanning heading "Capas de escayola (lado 1/lado 2)": three without absorbent in the cavity ("Sin cámara de absorción") and three with it ("Con cámara de absorción"), for one layer of plasterboard on each side (1/1), one and two (1/2) and two and two (2/2). Each column is a row here, with the framing as the name and the column as the variant, composed from the two printed headings above the cell.

The caption calls the values approximate ("Valores aproximados") and gives the plasterboard as 13 mm on both sides. The page prints no thickness, no surface density, no frequency band and no source for any row: the sound transmission class is all there is.
